services.name: Loon Cruises
services.desc: Gull Lake Cruises offers unforgettable experiences on the North Star yacht on Gull Lake. Watch the sun dip below the horizonon an evening dinner cruise. Embrace the tranquility of morning on a brunch cruise with scrumptious cuisine or take in the lake with a lunch or dinner cruise. Explore the scenic beauty of Gull Lake on a captivating journey through the Northwoods. With a variety of themed and special event cruises, Gull Lake Cruises provides a memorable experience through Minnesota’s most beautiful destination. Indulge in bold, smoky flavors and beautiful lake views aboard Cragun’s BBQ Dinner Cruise on Gull Lake - one of the summer’s most popular evening experiences. Enjoy a hearty BBQ

blurb: Guests cruise aboard the North Star, a 65-foot luxury motor yacht seating 98, with climate-controlled glass-enclosed main deck and upper deck patio. Public cruises include brunch, lunch, dinner, Cantina Dinner Cruise, and BBQ Cruises. Private charters and events are available for special occasions with food and drinks.
extraNote: Tickets refundable if cancelled by Gull Lake Cruises; reschedules honored at no charge · Public cruises require minimum 20 adult reservations to depart; refunds or reschedules offered if under 20 · No outside alcoholic beverages or food allowed onboard per Minnesota State Law · Gratuity for onboard staff not included; tipping recommended · Public cruises operate rain or shine unless severe weather · North Star yacht dock on Gull Lake, six miles north of Brainerd, MN
